info.title: API.SH: Just Eat
info.description: The Just Eat API from API.SH: public Just Eat data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Just Eat restaurant menu with prices and options
get.description:
The full menu of a Just Eat restaurant with its details: id, slug, name, link, description, address, postcode, city, coordinates, timezone, cuisines, halal and offline flags, allergen phone, opening times per service and day, logo and banner, menu languages and version; the menus per service (delivery, collection) with schedules, preparation time and ETA bands, and their categories (item ids); every item with description, labels (e.g. vegetarian), image, calories and each size variation's price, calories and the ids of its option groups and meal-deal groups; and the option groups (min/max choices, each option's extra price and calories) and meal-deal groups. With `hygiene=true` (UK) also the restaurant's food hygiene rating.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/justeat-menu

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The restaurant's just-eat.co.uk/restaurants-<slug>/menu link instead of slug.

parameters.name: hygiene
parameters.description: UK only: true adds `hygiene_rating` (rating, label, status, last inspection date, badge image).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Just Eat restaurant details, rating and fees
get.description:
One Just Eat restaurant's details: id, slug, name, link, description, star rating and number of ratings, cuisines, address, postcode, city, coordinates, area and timezone; delivery and collection support, open-now flags for each, next opening times and offline flag; delivery ETA range and collection ETA; delivery fee, fee bands by order value and minimum order (as quoted for the restaurant's own postcode, shown in `fees_for_postcode`); deals; opening times per service and day; halal, new and premier flags, tags, store type, allergen contact, alcohol licence, logo and banner, whether it holds a hygiene rating of 3+ / Pass (UK), with the original records in `raw`. With `hygiene=true` (UK) also the food hygiene rating itself (rating, label, status, last inspection date, badge). The menu itself: /justeat/v1/menu.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 3 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/justeat-restaurant

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The restaurant's just-eat.co.uk/restaurants-<slug>/menu link instead of slug.

parameters.name: hygiene
parameters.description: UK only: true adds `hygiene_rating` (rating, label, status, last inspection date, badge image).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Just Eat restaurants delivering to a postcode
get.description:
Every restaurant and shop Just Eat lists for a UK or Irish postcode: id, slug, name, link, address, coordinates, star rating and count, cuisines, drive distance, delivery and collection flags, open-now flags for delivery and collection, pre-order, next opening times, delivery and collection ETA, delivery fee, minimum order, fee bands by basket size, deals, tags, new and premier flags, logo and whether it holds a hygiene rating of 3+ / Pass (UK). Filters: cuisine, the site's refine filters (deals, free delivery, 4+ stars, open now, collection, new, hygiene rating, halal, meal deal), name search and service; sorts: recommended, rating, reviews, distance, delivery fee, minimum order, delivery time. The response lists the area's cuisines and filters with counts. `limit` sets the page size; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/justeat-restaurants

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: A full UK postcode (e.g. `EC4M 7RF`) or Irish Eircode.

parameters.name: cuisine
parameters.description: Cuisine values, comma-separated (any of them matches), e.g. `pizza`, `indian`, `burgers`, `sushi`; see available_filters.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Refine filters, comma-separated (all must match): with_discounts, free_delivery, four_star, open_now, collection, new, fsa, halal, meal_deal.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only restaurants whose name or cuisine contains this.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: recommended (default), rating, reviews, distance, delivery_fee, min_order or delivery_time.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Just Eat restaurant's customer reviews, newest first: review id, customer first name, date, rating out of the maximum, comment and the restaurant's reply. Pass next_cursor back as cursor for older reviews.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/justeat-reviews

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
